name: Ryūgasaki (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ryūgasaki city emblem in white: a ring of segments around a central ring, like a cog.
history: Municipal flag of Ryūgasaki, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 13 December 2013; the emblem dates from 15 June 1927.

features.role: Ryūgasaki city emblem — a ring of segments around a central ring, like a cog
